text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

Reps got about five hours back each week. Less typing, more selling.

CRM data got better. Notes were complete, timestamped, and consistent across the team.

Adoption wasn't automatic. Reps in the car or on a job site needed mobile-first workflows, not desktop ones.

Customers cared about consent. Asking upfront took ten seconds and built trust.

Managers used summaries for coaching, but only after we agreed they wouldn't be used for surveillance.

The biggest lesson: the tool mattered less than the rollout. Clear rules, a short training, and honest feedback loops made the difference.

What would you test next in your own team's pilot?
